242:     def _truncate_at_finish(
243:         action_events: list[ActionEvent],
244:     ) -> tuple[list[ActionEvent], bool]:
245:         """
246:         Return (events[:finish+1], True) or (events, False).
247:         Discards and logs any calls after FinishTool.
248:         """
249:         finish_idx = next(
250:             (
251:                 i
252:                 for i, ae in enumerate(action_events)
253:                 if ae.tool_name == FinishTool.name
254:             ),
255:             None,
256:         )
257:         if finish_idx is None:
258:             return action_events, False
259: 
260:         discarded = action_events[finish_idx + 1 :]
261:         if discarded:
262:             names = [ae.tool_name for ae in discarded]
263:             logger.warning(
264:                 f"Discarding {len(discarded)} tool call(s) "
265:                 f"after FinishTool: {', '.join(names)}"
266:             )
267:         return action_events[: finish_idx + 1], True
